fold.label: Unfold the figure into its crease pattern
fold.caption: The figure is what you see on screen: the interface. Unfold it and you get the folds that shape it, the architecture. Each identity folds its own: a crane, a blue morpho by day and a red-eyed tree frog by night, an arctic fox. "See how this page is built" opens any page here the same way.

replay2022.intro: This is the code from the table, compiled to WebAssembly and running on your device. It places the essay's 14 pieces one at a time, as it did in 2022.
replay2022.slower: With {count}, the 2022 code ran at {times}× the plain version's speed: slower, as it was then.
replay2022.faster: With {count}, the 2022 code ran {times}× faster than the plain version on this device.
replay2022.differentBoard: The threaded run also ended on a different board. When two moves score the same, the 2022 code keeps the one from whichever thread takes the lock first, so the result can change from run to run.
replay2022.changes: It's the 2022 code with two changes: it no longer prints every move or writes a file per level, and four memory bugs are fixed. Times come from its own clock.
replay2022.noSharedMemory: This browser doesn't allow shared memory on this page, so only the plain version runs.
replay2022.serialOnly: The plain version took {ms} ms on this device. The threaded one can't run here.
replay2022.failed: The 2022 code couldn't run here. Reload the page to try again.
